summary: Iteration 7 - Feature validation: Daily Pulse, Smart Nudges, Family Optimize (Pro), Duplicate AI best-shot. Backend: 16/16 pytest passed (auth guards, pulse before/after check + idempotent same-day retry, nudges shape + priority sort, family list/optimize/404, duplicates photos[]+best_index). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, web preview): Home renders daily-pulse-card, nudges list, Family screen shows per-member health score badge + 'Optimize remotely' Pro action which updates the member to score>=90 with 'Optimized just now' text, Duplicates screen shows 'AI auto-picks the sharpest shot' note and per-group 'AI keeps best · N%' badges. Auth flow verified via seeded Mongo session (feat-token-123) + localStorage. No blocker issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1370 lines - consider splitting per-feature routers (pulse/nudges/family/coach) into separate modules for maintainability.

AsyncStorage 'dp:onboarded' key duplication (both 'dp:onboarded' and '@AsyncStorage:dp:onboarded') was needed during testing to bypass onboarding; verify AsyncStorage web driver uses the correct prefix so onboarding gate doesn't false-trigger returning users.
Home index.tsx: initial load fires api.streak()+api.forecast() twice (mount effect + useFocusEffect) - minor extra requests each focus.
seed_data_creation: Used pre-seeded user 'user_feat_test' with session_token 'feat-token-123'. Test cleared db.pulse_checks for that user before/after run. Test created 'TEST_Optimize' family member if none existed (auto-cleanup on account deletion; safe to leave since it's isolated to the test user).
context_for_next_testing_agent: For frontend testing seed BOTH localStorage keys: dp_session_token=<token>, dp:onboarded=1 AND @AsyncStorage:dp:onboarded=1. Then navigate to '/' (root) and wait for [data-testid=home-screen]. Direct nav to /(tabs) is unreliable because splash route enforces the onboarding gate. On web, Platform.OS==='web' auto-unlocks Pro so family optimize is testable.
rca_of_issue: No production issues found. Only a testing-setup wrinkle: AsyncStorage web adapter for the onboarding flag prefixes keys, so tests must set both raw and prefixed forms to skip onboarding.
